1.text: Nuko muri iyo minsi itegeko riva kwa Kayisari Awugusito, ngo abo mu bihugu bye bose bandikwe.

2.text: Uko ni ko kwandikwa kwa mbere, kwabayeho Kureniyo ategeka i Siriya.

3.text: Bose bajya kwiyandikisha, umuntu wese ajya mu mudugudu w'iwabo.

4.text: Yosefu na we ava i Galilaya mu mudugudu w'i Nazareti, ajya i Yudaya mu mudugudu wa Dawidi witwa i Betelehemu, kuko yari uwo mu nzu ya Dawidi no mu muryango we,

5.text: ajya kwiyandikishanya na Mariya, uwo yasabye wari utwite.

6.text: Bakiri iyo igihe cye cyo kubyara kirasohora,

7.text: abyara umuhungu w'imfura amworosa imyenda y'impinja, amuryamisha mu muvure w'inka kuko bari babuze umwanya mu icumbi.

8.text: Muri icyo gihugu harimo abungeri bararaga ku gikumba, bahindana kurinda umukumbi wabo.

9.text: Nuko marayika w'Umwami Imana abahagarara iruhande, ubwiza bw'Umwami burabagirana bubagota impande zose bagira ubwoba bwinshi.

10.text: Marayika arababwira ati “Mwitinya, dore ndababwira ubutumwa bwiza bw'umunezero mwinshi uzaba ku bantu bose,

11.text: kuko uyu munsi Umukiza abavukiye mu murwa wa Dawidi, uzaba Kristo Umwami.

12.text: Iki ni cyo kiri bubabere ikimenyetso: ni uko muri busange umwana w'uruhinja yoroshwe imyenda y'impinja, aryamishijwe mu muvure w'inka.”

13.text: Muri ako kanya haboneka ingabo zo mu ijuru nyinshi ziri kumwe na marayika uwo, zisingiza Imana ziti

14.text: “Mu ijuru icyubahiro kibe icy'Imana,No mu isi amahoro abe mu bo yishimira.”

15.text: Abamarayika bamaze gusubira mu ijuru abungeri baravugana bati “Nimuze tujye i Betelehemu turebe ibyabayeyo, ibyo Umwami Imana itumenyesheje.”

16.text: Bagenda bihuta, basanga Mariya na Yosefu n'umwana w'uruhinja aryamishijwe mu muvure w'inka.

17.text: Babibonye babatekerereza iby'uwo mwana nk'uko babibwiwe.

18.text: Ababumvise bose batangazwa n'ibyo abungeri bababwiye.

19.text: Ariko Mariya abika ayo magambo yose mu mutima we, akajya ayatekereza.

20.text: Maze abungeri basubirayo bahimbaza, bashima Imana ku byo bumvise byose no ku byo babonye nk'uko babibwiwe.

21.text: Nuko iminsi munani ishize arakebwa bamwita Yesu, rya zina ryari ryaravuzwe na marayika, nyina atarasama inda ye.

22.text: Iminsi yo kwezwa kwabo ishize, bakurikije amategeko ya Mose, bamujyana i Yerusalemu ngo bamumurikire Umwami Imana,

23.text: (nk'uko byanditswe mu mategeko y'Umwami ngo “Umuhungu wese w'uburiza azitwa uwera ku Uwiteka”),

24.text: batamba n'igitambo nk'uko byavuzwe mu mategeko y'Umwami ngo “Intungura ebyiri cyangwa ibyana by'inuma bibiri.”

25.text: I Yerusalemu hariho umuntu witwaga Simiyoni. Uwo yari umukiranutsi witonda kandi yategerezaga Ihumure ry'Abisirayeli, Umwuka Wera yari muri we.

26.text: Yari yarahanuriwe n'Umwuka Wera, ko atazapfa atarabona Kristo w'Umwami Imana.

27.text: Ajyanwa n'Umwuka mu rusengero, maze ababyeyi bajyanye umwana Yesu ngo bamugenze nk'uko umuhango w'amategeko wari uri,

29.text: “Mwami, noneho urasezerere umugaragu wawe amahoro nk'uko wabivuze,

30.text: Kuko amaso yanjye abonye agakiza kawe,

31.text: Ako witeguye mu maso y'abantu bose,

32.text: Kuba umucyo uvira amahanga,No kuba ubwiza bw'ubwoko bwawe bw'Abisirayeli.”

33.text: Se na nyina batangazwa n'ayo magambo avuzwe kuri we.

34.text: Simiyoni abaha impundu abwira nyina Mariya ati “Dore uyu ashyiriweho kugira ngo benshi mu Bisirayeli bagwe, benshi babyuke, abe n'ikimenyetso kigīrwa impaka,

35.text: ngo ibyo abantu benshi batekereza mu mitima bizahishurwe, kandi nawe inkota izagucumita mu mutima.”

36.text: Hariho n'umuhanuzikazi witwaga Ana, mwene Fanuweli wo mu muryango wa Asheri, yari umukecuru wa kera. Amaze gushyingirwa yamaranye n'umugabo we imyaka irindwi,

37.text: noneho amara imyaka mirongo inani n'ine ari umupfakazi. Yahoraga mu rusengero aramya Imana, yiyiriza ubusa, asenga ku manywa na nijoro.

38.text: Muri uwo mwanya na we araza ashima Imana, avuga ibya Yesu abibwira bose bari bategereje gucungurwa kw'i Yerusalemu.

39.text: Ababyeyi ba Yesu barangije ibyategetswe n'amategeko y'Umwami Imana byose, basubira i Galilaya mu mudugudu wabo i Nazareti.

40.text: Nuko uwo mwana arakura, agwiza imbaraga, yuzuzwa ubwenge kandi ubuntu bw'Imana bwari muri we.

41.text: Uko umwaka utashye, ababyeyi be bajyaga i Yerusalemu mu minsi mikuru ya Pasika.

42.text: Nuko amaze imyaka cumi n'ibiri avutse, barazamuka nk'uko umugenzo w'iyo minsi mikuru wari uri.

43.text: Bamaze iyo minsi basubirayo, uwo mwana Yesu asigara i Yerusalemu ababyeyi be batabizi.

44.text: Icyakora bibwiraga yuko ari mu itara ry'abantu bajyanye na bo, nuko bagenda urugendo rw'umunsi umwe maze bamushakira muri bene wabo no mu ncuti zabo,

46.text: Hashize iminsi itatu bamubona mu rusengero yicaye hagati y'abigisha, abateze amatwi kandi ababaza.

47.text: Abamwumvise bose batangazwa n'ubwenge bwe n'ibyo abasubiza.

48.text: Bamubonye baratangara nyina aramubaza ati “Mwana wanjye, ni iki cyatumye utugenza utya? Dore jye na so twagushatse dufite umutima uhagaze.”

49.text: Arabasubiza ati “Mwanshakiraga iki? Ntimuzi yuko binkwiriye kuba mu rugo rwa Data?”

51.text: Amanukana na bo ajya i Nazareti, agahora abumvira. Ibyo byose nyina abibika mu mutima we.

52.text: Yesu akomeza kugwiza ubwenge, abyiruka ashimwa n'Imana n'abantu.
